{
  "summary": "Removes the `removeprunedfunds` RPC and deletes all underlying wallet transaction-removal code (`CWallet::RemoveTxs` and `WalletBatch::EraseTx`). Because the deletion infrastructure is removed, legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration no longer erases watch-only transactions from the migrated non-watch-only wallet. Deprecation warnings, test cases for transaction deletion, and release notes are updated accordingly.",
  "problem": "The `removeprunedfunds` RPC was deprecated in v32 and retained dangerous transaction deletion logic that required complex synchronization between in-memory structures and wallet storage. Furthermore, during legacy wallet migration, deleting watch-only transactions from the main wallet added database overhead and complexity for no practical benefit.",
  "evidence": [
    "The RPC was deprecated in v32 (PR #35605).",
    "Author commit message (c7dfd82edb): \"There is never a good reason to delete tx data from a wallet, so delete these functions.\"",
    "Author PR description: \"AFAICT for both GUI and RPC having irrelevant transactions inside of wallet is harmless and does not affect the output of anything, since most stuff is gated behind IsMine() anyways.\""
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "depends_on": [],
    "enables": []
  },
  "scope_notes": "Deletes the RPC endpoint, wallet internal removal routines, and associated functional/unit tests.",
  "changed_since_previous": "Added release notes documenting the removal of `removeprunedfunds`.",
  "card": "Deletes the `removeprunedfunds` RPC (deprecated in v32) and completely removes all transaction deletion logic from the wallet memory structures and database layer. Legacy wallet migration will no longer delete watch-only transactions from the migrated main wallet, keeping non-owned transactions stored harmlessly without affecting balances. This permanently removes obsolete and potentially problematic transaction-erasure routines across the wallet subsystem.",

result.summary: Removes the `removeprunedfunds` RPC and deletes all underlying wallet transaction-removal code (`CWallet::RemoveTxs` and `WalletBatch::EraseTx`). Because the deletion infrastructure is removed, legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration no longer erases watch-only transactions from the migrated non-watch-only wallet. Deprecation warnings, test cases for transaction deletion, and release notes are updated accordingly.
result.problem: The `removeprunedfunds` RPC was deprecated in v32 and retained dangerous transaction deletion logic that required complex synchronization between in-memory structures and wallet storage. Furthermore, during legacy wallet migration, deleting watch-only transactions from the main wallet added database overhead and complexity for no practical benefit.
evidence: The RPC was deprecated in v32 (PR #35605).
Author commit message (c7dfd82edb): "There is never a good reason to delete tx data from a wallet, so delete these functions."

Author PR description: "AFAICT for both GUI and RPC having irrelevant transactions inside of wallet is harmless and does not affect the output of anything, since most stuff is gated behind IsMine() anyways."
result.scope_notes: Deletes the RPC endpoint, wallet internal removal routines, and associated functional/unit tests.
result.changed_since_previous: Added release notes documenting the removal of `removeprunedfunds`.
result.card: Deletes the `removeprunedfunds` RPC (deprecated in v32) and completely removes all transaction deletion logic from the wallet memory structures and database layer. Legacy wallet migration will no longer delete watch-only transactions from the migrated main wallet, keeping non-owned transactions stored harmlessly without affecting balances. This permanently removes obsolete and potentially problematic transaction-erasure routines across the wallet subsystem.

risk.why: Leaving unowned transactions in migrated wallets or modifying wallet database manipulation code could break wallet accounting or transaction reporting if any RPCs fail to filter by IsMine.
